u0: No siren, client order, food preparation, or fallen-food obligation is currently pending. The agent is free to handle the next event: silence the siren when it rings, take a new client's order, then fetch and prepare food and serve it.
u1: The siren is ringing and has not yet been silenced, so the agent still needs to reach the siren switch and toggle it. No client order or food-handling obligation is outstanding at this stage.
u10: Prepared food has slipped out of the agent's hands. The agent must pick it up on the very next step and then serve it to the waiting client; the order has already been prepared, so serving is the remaining food-related task.
u11: Prepared food has just slipped and the siren is ringing. The agent must recover the food on the next step, then serve the waiting client and silence the siren.
u12: A client has arrived at the counter and is waiting, but the order has not been taken yet. The agent needs to go to the client and take the order, after which it must fetch and prepare food and serve it.
u13: A client is waiting to have an order taken, and the siren is ringing. The agent still needs to take the client's order and silence the siren, before continuing with food preparation and service.
u14: A client is at the counter and prepared food is ready. The agent still needs to take the waiting client's order and serve the prepared food; the order must be handled before the client can be given food.
u15: A client is waiting to order, prepared food is ready, and the siren is ringing. The agent still needs to take the order, serve the prepared food, and silence the siren.
u16: A client has arrived and food has just slipped from the agent's hands. The immediate requirement is to pick the food up on the very next step; the client's order still has to be taken before food can be prepared and served.
u17: A client has arrived, food has just slipped, and the siren is ringing. The agent must recover the food on the next step, then take the client's order and silence the siren before continuing with preparation and service.
u18: A client is waiting, prepared food is ready, and the food has just slipped. The next move must recover the fallen prepared food; afterwards the agent must take the client's order and serve the prepared food.
u19: A client is waiting, prepared food is ready, the food has just slipped, and the siren is ringing. The agent must pick up the food on the next step, then take the client's order, serve the prepared food, and silence the siren.
u2: A client's order has been taken, but the food for it has not yet been prepared. The agent still needs to obtain raw food and prepare it at the stove, then serve the prepared food to the waiting client.
u20: An order has already been taken but its food has not yet been prepared, and a client has arrived whose order still needs to be taken. Take that client's order, prepare food for the outstanding order at the stove, and serve it once prepared. No siren alarm or urgent food recovery is currently owed.
u21: The siren is ringing and still needs to be turned off. An order has already been taken but its food has not yet been prepared, and a client has arrived whose order still needs taking. After preparing the outstanding food, serve it to the waiting client.
u22: The food has just slipped and must be picked up again on the very next move, or the task fails for good. An order also remains to be prepared, and a client has arrived whose order still needs taking. No siren alarm is active, so the immediate food recovery can be handled first.
u23: The food has just fallen and must be back in the agent's hands on the very next step to avoid permanent failure. The siren is also ringing and still needs to be turned off. An order remains to be prepared, and a client has arrived whose order still needs taking; those jobs continue after the immediate recovery.
u24: Prepared food is waiting to be served, and an order has been taken whose food still needs preparing. Complete the outstanding preparation at the stove and serve the prepared food to the waiting client. No siren alarm or urgent food recovery is currently owed.
u25: The siren is ringing and still needs to be turned off. Prepared food remains to be served, and an order has been taken whose food still needs preparing. The remaining jobs are to silence the siren, prepare the outstanding order, and serve the prepared food.
u26: The food has just slipped and must be back in hand on the very next step, or the task fails for good. Prepared food still needs serving, and an order has been taken whose food still needs preparing. Recover the fallen food first; the prepared food can then be served and the outstanding order prepared.
u27: The food has just fallen and must be recovered on the very next step to avoid permanent failure. The siren is ringing and still needs to be turned off. Prepared food remains to be served, and an order has been taken whose food still needs preparing. Recover the food first, then deal with the siren and the remaining preparation and service.
u28: A mandatory recovery rule has been broken for good: the food fell and was not back in the agent's hands on the following step. Successful completion is no longer possible, and this failure cannot be reversed.
u29: Prepared food still needs to be served, an order already taken still needs its food prepared, and a client has arrived whose order has not yet been taken. Take the arrived client's order, prepare the outstanding food, and serve the prepared food. No siren alarm or urgent food recovery is currently owed.
u3: A client's order has been taken and the siren is ringing. The agent still needs to silence the siren and, separately, obtain and prepare food for the waiting client before serving it.
u30: The siren is ringing and still needs to be turned off. Prepared food remains to be served, an order already taken still needs its food prepared, and a client has arrived whose order still needs taking. The remaining work includes silencing the siren and carrying out the outstanding preparation, service, and order-taking jobs.
u31: The food has just fallen and must be recovered on the very next step, or the task fails permanently. Prepared food still needs serving, an order already taken still needs preparing, and a client has arrived whose order still needs taking. Recover the food first; the other outstanding jobs remain afterward.
u32: The food has just fallen and must be back in the agent's hands on the next step to avoid permanent failure. The siren is ringing and still needs to be turned off. Prepared food remains to be served, an order already taken remains to be prepared, and a client who has arrived still needs their order taken. Recover the food first, then handle the siren and the remaining order work.
u4: Food has been prepared and is ready to serve, while the waiting client's order remains unfinished. The agent needs to take the prepared food to the client and hand it over; no siren obligation is currently outstanding.
u5: Prepared food is ready and the siren is ringing. The agent still must serve the waiting client and silence the siren; these remaining tasks can be handled in either order as the shop allows.
u6: Food has just slipped out of the agent's hands. It must be picked up on the very next step, or the requirement to recover fallen food will be broken; no other client or siren obligation is pending.
u7: Food has just slipped and the siren is also ringing. The agent must recover the food on the very next step, then still silence the siren later.
u8: A client's order has been taken, but the food has just slipped from the agent's hands. The next step must be used to pick the food up again; after that, the agent still needs to prepare food and serve the waiting client.
u9: A client's order is pending preparation, the food has just slipped, and the siren is ringing. The immediate priority is to pick up the food on the next step; preparing and serving the order and silencing the siren remain to be done.
